propositions: Environment-read helpers absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS are silently ignored during registry generation, causing env-var names to be dropped from documentation.

_gate_str_pref and read_secret_env are unregistered helper functions whose parameter-referenced env-reads are invisible to the scanner, causing REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE to be undocumented despite being advertised in CLI help.

A function whose os.environ key expression references one of its own parameters can be detected as a parameterized-shim and should fail the build if not registered, making helper recognition fail-closed symmetrically with os.environ attribute recognition.

The parameterized-shim predicate (a parameter-referenced env-read) is enumerable and sparse (9 hits across 557 files), making fail-closed detection feasible without excessive false positives or requiring new naming conventions.
